recordedBy: claude-code-session under explicit owner instruction; the authorisation itself is the owner's

boundFrame.frameHashAndFileShaAreNotTheSameValue: frameHash covers the canonical serialization of the frame payload with the frameHash field excluded, and is stable under reformatting. artifactFileSha256 covers the committed file bytes. They are reported apart and never conflated. A1b reverifies both before it reads a single entry.

why: the historical 49-item DEVELOPMENT fixture carries a stable echeRowKey
A0 created fresh organisation UUIDs, so historical organisationId values do not survive database reconstruction
all 12 historical echeRowKey values do survive
matching on the current organisationId would silently have excluded nothing
acceptedA1IdentityFinding.isTheCorrectImplementationOf: contributes no item to the historical DEVELOPMENT set

whatA1bMayDo: create the minimal pure tooling required to implement frozen SD2
read exactly one input: the frozen FRAME_V2_GEN1 artifact named above
deterministically rank the already-frozen A1 eligible frame by sha256 of the exact UTF-8 echeRowKey bytes
assign the 110 selection slots to the frozen 20/45/45 SPLIT_ASSIGNMENT_CYCLE_V2_R2 split cycle
materialise and commit exactly one DRAW_V2_GEN1 artifact, with its drawHash
whatA1bMayNotDo: issue any network request of any kind
open any database connection, read or write
resolve a root authority identifier into a URL, hostname, registrable domain, sitemap or robots path
consume a reserve entry or perform a replacement
create a page identity, an item identity, a document hash, gold or a classifier output
create a DEV_CONFIRM or FINAL_HOLDOUT manifest
create any extra human-readable list of holdout or confirm organisations
execute A2, page selection, labelling, provider inference, Prompt V7, DEV_CONFIRM evaluation, FINAL_HOLDOUT access or Phase 2E

frozenAlgorithm.hashedBytes: the UTF-8 bytes of the EXACT echeRowKey string stored in the frozen frame
frozenAlgorithm.sortOrder: ascending, bytewise/plain lexicographic comparison over the 64-character string
frozenAlgorithm.splitAssignment: SPLIT_ASSIGNMENT_CYCLE_V2_R2[i mod 22] where i is the 0-based selectionIndex

frameIsTheOnlyInput.statement: A1 already projected all SD1 eligibility into the immutable frame. A1b consumes entries where included === true and nothing else.
stopConditions: a duplicate organisationId exists among eligible entries
an eligible entry lacks usable root authority metadata
two distinct echeRowKey values produce the same rankHash

noAcquisitionUrlDerivation.statement: The draw carries authority identifiers from the frozen frame and nothing that could be requested.
noAcquisitionUrlDerivation.resolvedLaterUnder: A2 authority, from the database / approved root-authority path

drawHashing.drawHash: SHA-256 over the canonical draw payload EXCLUDING the drawHash field
drawHashing.canonicalJsonConvention: the same canonicalStringify convention A1 used, unless a mechanically necessary difference exists
drawHashing.artifactFileSha256: SHA-256 of the final complete artifact bytes, computed separately

immutability.thisRecordIsNeverEdited: A correction is a NEW record that references this one by SHA-256. This file is never rewritten, re-hashed or re-statused.
immutability.boundBytesAreNotCopiedHere: Every value quoted above is quoted from the frozen R3 bytes, the approved Plan V1 bytes, the committed FRAME_V2_GEN1 bytes, or the owner instruction that produced this record. No approved artifact is restated here in a form that could drift from it, and no approved artifact's bytes change because this record exists.
